title: Thought Experiments and Universal Principles
goal: Frame ethical principles and thought experiments using universal gnomic conditionals and mixed si-clauses.
grammar: universal gnomic si + present + present and mixed si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional perfect

items: I can build mixed conditionals (si + imperfect subjunctive + habría + participle) to link timeless conditions to past outcomes.
I can state universal ethical rules and counterexamples with gnomic si + present + present.
I can discuss promises and ethical legitimacy (la promesa, el vínculo, la legitimidad, el contraejemplo, perjudicar, beneficiar, quebrantar).
